method: Whole-file manual reading of Sunburst.h and Sunburst.cpp, pinned bytes verified. No runtime tests in this increment.
findings: Depth is clamped to 1..64 and additionally bounded by available radius and minimum ring width. Traversal uses an explicit pending vector, not recursive calls. Ring indexes may repeat visual-leaf entries across multiple depths; no whole-memory budget established.

Children are assumed size-sorted. At the first zero or sector smaller than the stroke/hit threshold, traversal stops; omitted bytes are represented by a residual sector owned by the parent. This preserves aggregate context without giving each omitted file a distinct hit target.
Child size is bounded by remaining parent bytes before addition. Angular arithmetic converts u64 to double; exact proportional geometry for extreme size ratios is not guaranteed by source.

Layout cache depends on root pointer, render rectangle, depth and DPI; content changes at the same root require external invalidation. Font percentage affects geometry but is not an explicit cache-key field. Caller-triggered invalidation coverage remains unqualified.
ClearLayout drops borrowed pointers and index entries, while TrimMemory also swaps containers to release capacity. Cached root and entries do not own CItem lifetime.

Hit testing uses radius-to-ring conversion and upper_bound on angular end positions. Debug assertions check start/end sortedness. Outline lookup falls back to a remainder or visible ancestor for an omitted item.

Rendering draws all stored sectors and gathers label candidates. The 8..128 density budget only limits additional leaf labels: directory labels are attempted first without that cap. Reserve(128/256) does not bound candidate-vector growth.
UI font family name is initialized once in a static string. Live font changes and actual GDI+ text placement require Windows runtime qualification.
limits: No Windows build, GUI rendering, font-change, cache-invalidation, memory profiling or hit-test runtime execution performed.
No foreign production code adopted; native pHash investigation remains deferred. Global completed repository count remains 147/500.
